. ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACTS OF THE PROPOSED ACTION
3.1.1 Land Peatures and Uses
Page 3-1
According to Crescent Land and Timber, loblolly is not a species of commercial value in this area. The three acres occupied by the transmission towers will also be seeded and not excluded as indicated. The 31-mile long corridor will extend from the vicinity of the Lower Whitewater Falls to Table Bock State Park.
Section 3.1.1 has been revised.
3.1.1.2 Scenic and Esthetic Resources
Page 3-3
The second paragraph should be reworded to read: "During construction activity, landscape characteristics of the area within the upper reservoir site would change drastically, with some changes in the surrounding areas. This impact would be temporary for the duration of those activities."
Section 3.1.1 has been revised to clarify this paragraph.
Add to paragraph three: "Most of this acreage would be in the reservoir basin and would be ultimately inundated."
Section 3.1.1 has been revised to include this point.
3.1.2.1 Flora
Page 3-4
In paragraph two dealing with the clearing for the transmission line, applicant intends to clear around tower locations and in areas where a line clearance of 30 feet above the tree tops is not possible. As proposed, clearing of the transmission line would be accomplished by selective cutting as transmission towers would be placed on the highest elevations when possible. Selective cutting will be used to the fullest extent possible minimizing the need to clear all vegetation from beneath the lines.
Section 3.1.2 has been revised.
3.1.2.2 Fauna
Page 3-6
in the third paragraph, the DEIS states that the Staff are uncertain as to the exact impact of the construction upon populations of endangered species. Endangered species is assumed to mean those on the published list of endangered species. There is no evidence that any of these species inhabit the project area with the exception of a lone sighting of a bald eagle in flight at Lake Keowee on August 18, 1974.
No comment or change is felt to be necessary. The referenced section is accurate as stated.
